description: AmneziaWG 3.x between two endpoints in this repository, userspace device (system=false). Same topology and payload as wireguard-endpoint, with the obfuscation parameters enabled on both ends, so the difference between the two cells is the AWG graft rather than the load model.

extra.known_limits: userspace endpoint: download and UDP do not carry traffic reliably in this configuration; see docs/perf/FAILURES.md#b7
